content:
Track: SQL Foundations
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: SQL WHERE Clauses
    - Lesson 4: SQL JOIN Operations (Inner, Outer)
    - Lesson 5: Advanced SQL Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses
    - Lesson 6: Subqueries and Nested SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 7: SQL ORDER BY Clause and Sorting Data
    - Lesson 8: Advanced Joins (LEFT OUTER JOIN, RIGHT OUTER JOIN)
    - Lesson 9: Database Normalization and Design
    - Lesson 10: SQL Performance Optimization Techniques

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Python Introduction and Setup
    - Lesson 2: Data Structures (Lists, Tuples, Dictionaries)
    - Lesson 3: Functions and Modules in Python
    - Lesson 4: Working with CSV Files in Python
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to NumPy and Pandas
    - Lesson 6: Data Cleaning Techniques (missing values, outliers)
    - Lesson 7: Data Manipulation with Pandas
    - Lesson 8: Intro to Matplotlib and Line Charts

   Track: Intermediate Python and Pandas
    - Lesson 1: Data Merging and Reshaping in Pandas
    - Lesson 2: Time Series Analysis with Pandas
    - Lesson 3: Introduction to Data Visualization (Scatter Plots, Histograms)
    - Lesson 4: Statistical Analysis in Python (Mean, Median, Mode, Standard Deviation)
    - Lesson 5: Grouping and Aggregating Data in Pandas
    - Lesson 6: Advanced Filtering Techniques in Pandas
    - Lesson 7: Data Transformation with Pandas Functions
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Data Validation and Quality Checks

   Track: SQL for Data Analysts (Advanced)
    - Lesson 1: Advanced SQL Techniques (Cascading Joins, Common Table Expressions)
    - Lesson 2: Performance Tuning for Large Databases
    - Lesson 3: Database Indexing and Optimization
    - Lesson 4: Data Extraction with SQL (SELECT INTO, UNION ALL)
    - Lesson 5: Data Loading into SQL using Python (SQLAlchemy, pyodbc)
    - Lesson 6: Data Modeling for Advanced Analytics
    - Lesson 7: Introduction to SQL Views and Materialized Views
    - Lesson 8: Database Maintenance and Monitoring

   Track: Intermediate Data Visualization with Python (Advanced)
    - Lesson 1: Building Bar Charts in Matplotlib
    - Lesson 2: Building Box Plots in Matplotlib
    - Lesson 3: Building Scatter Plots with Multiple Lines (Line Plot Matrix)
    - Lesson 4: Introduction to Seaborn Library for Data Visualization
    - Lesson 5: Creating Heatmaps and Correlation Matrices
    - Lesson 6: Interactive Data Visualizations using Bokeh and Dash
    - Lesson 7: Building Dashboards with Python, Pandas, and SQL
    - Lesson 8: Advanced Data Visualization Techniques (Clustering, Regression Analysis)
